title: HAALAND SCORES THE WINNER AND STILL TELLS CITY TO STEP UP
description:
13 goals against Leipzig, 13 touches on the night. And Haaland still wanted more from his team.

It was the 78th minute at Leipzig when Erling Haaland scored the winner, his fourteenth goal of the season. City won three-two. They came in after losing two league games in a row, the last one to Brighton.

Leipzig should put him on their season-ticket list: thirteen goals in nine appearances against them, more than against any other opponent. Afterwards he said City should have been more aggressive after going ahead.

A winner, thirteen touches and a team talk. Fair enough, Erling? Or is it a bit much after a win? Fair or harsh, tell us below.
